Draft a high-quality issue for: <problem/request>

Inspect enough repository context to make the issue actionable without prescribing an unverified implementation.

Include:
- concise title;
- problem/user impact;
- current vs expected behavior or desired outcome;
- reproduction/evidence for bugs;
- acceptance criteria;
- affected area/environment;
- security/privacy/config/migration considerations;
- dependencies/blockers;
- validation expectations.

Never include secrets/private data. Clearly mark unknowns instead of inventing details.
